measurement_status_note: Corrected pointer handling, calibrated exact least-squares tone estimator, complete chronological timing sections, final=true Stretcher drain, and explicit LiveShifter silence flush; no hardware/XRUN or production-selection evidence.
scope: TEMP standalone comparison only; GPL-2.0-or-later/commercial dual-license library is not linked to product; no hardware or XRUN evidence
license: GPL-2.0-or-later; commercial license required for non-GPL redistribution
build_flags: Rubber Band Meson release optimization=3, static, builtin FFT/resampler, tests disabled; harness /O2 /std:c++17 /EHsc /MD
os: Microsoft Windows 11 专业版 10.0.26200 64 位
stereo_policy: channels together; right channel is 0.7 of left
signal_scenes: 440 Hz sine gated: silence 0.2s, 5ms raised-cosine attack, sustain to 0.8s, 40ms cosine-squared release
frequency_estimator: Hann-windowed Goertzel coarse scan near expected shifted tones, then golden-section minimization of exact least-squares residual with sinusoid(s)+DC; independent ideal-tone calibration per scene
timing_scope: Raw chronological per-call process+available+retrieve Stretcher and fixed-size shift LiveShifter arrays; pad/startup/warmup/steady/final/flush arrays are exhaustive and unsorted; over-budget counts compare each call with its real block budget
finalization: Stretcher sends final=true on its last audio block then drains until available<=0; LiveShifter has no final flag and receives ceil(reportedDelay/blockSize) silence blocks whose timing/output are reported separately; delay-trimmed lengths are raw, not assumed audio-tail alignment
